title: Encode N-ary Tree to Binary Tree
description: Encode an N-ary tree into a binary tree such that each node's children are represented by a linked list structure in the binary tree.
pseudocode:
1. If node is null, return null
2. rootNode = new TreeNode(node.val)
3. If node.children is not empty:
4.   rootNode.left = encode(node.children[0])
5.   curr = rootNode.left
6.   For i = 1 to node.children.length - 1:
7.     curr.right = encode(node.children[i])
8.     curr = curr.right
9. Return rootNode

steps.note: Initialize root (val: 1) of the binary tree.
Process first child (val: 2) as left child.
Set current pointer to the left child.
Process second child (val: 3) as right sibling of the first child.
Move pointer to the next sibling.
